summary.name: HyperKitty
summary.one_liner: HyperKitty is the web archiver for GNU Mailman 3 that lets users browse, search, and reply to mailing list threads, and can also run standalone as a web forum.
use_cases: Browsing and searching mailing list archives
Replying to mailing list threads from a web browser
Running a web forum without the full Mailman suite
Providing a modern web front end for Mailman 3 lists
Marking important list messages as favorites
summary.what_it_does: HyperKitty is the archiver project for the Mailman 3 suite. It lets users browse mailing lists, start new threads, reply to existing threads, mark messages as favorites, and search archives. It is a Django-based web application. It can run standalone without the rest of Mailman to serve as a web forum. The source code is hosted on GitLab, and the page links to a development setup guide and two demo servers.
notable: Archiver for GNU Mailman 3, originally started by the Fedora community
Can run standalone as a web forum without the rest of Mailman
Built as a Django application that can be reused in other Django projects
Source code hosted on GitLab with an issue tracker
caveats: Demo servers are development servers and may be broken or obsolete
Standalone deployment needs only the hyperkitty and hyperkitty_standalone components
